newsitem.title: USA: One Valley to dismiss FDIC suit.
newsitem.headline: One Valley to dismiss FDIC suit.

text.p: One Valley Bancorp said on Friday its One Valley Bank NA was joining with the U.S. Federal Deposit Insurance Corp to dismiss litigation regarding the proper assesment for certain deposits.

In June, One Valley said it was suing the FDIC to cut premiums it pays to insure certain deposits. One Valley said then that it believed it was overpaying its ongoing insurance assessment by over $800,00 per year.
But the company said it would dismiss its pending legislation because of recent federal legislation which reduced assessment rates on these deposits.
